translation: The Blessed Lord said: Absolute fearlessness (abhayam), complete purification of the inner psyche, unswerving alignment in the Yoga of wisdom, generous charity, control over the physical senses, performance of sacrifices for public good, systematic study of scripture (svadhyayaha), self-discipline, and straight integrity;

Non-violence, unyielding truthfulness, complete absence of anger, spirit of sacrifice, inner tranquility, refusal to slander or backbite (apaishunam), universal compassion toward all living creatures, freedom from greed, gentle mildness, modesty, and absence of reckless, volatile movement;

Radiant courage, patient forgiveness, rock-solid fortitude, internal cleanliness, complete freedom from malicious hostility, and absolute absence of overweening vanity—these character traits belong to one who is born with the alignment of divine wealth (daivim sampadam), O descendant of Bharata!

Ostentatious vanity, raw pride, arrogance, explosive anger, harsh cruelty in speech and action, and dense ignorance—these traits belong to one who is born with the alignment of demonic wealth (asurim sampadam), O Partha!

The divine wealth leads straight to ultimate liberation, while the demonic track is the secure path to permanent psychological bondage. Do not mourn or slide into anxiety, O Pandava, for you have been born fully endowed with the divine alignment!

There are two primary behavioral lineages of human beings operating in this world—the divine and the demonic, O Partha! The divine track has already been described to you in extensive detail; listen now to My breakdown of the demonic character.

Those of demonic nature have absolutely no comprehension regarding what actions are fit to be done (pravrittim) and what are fit to be avoided (nivrattim). Neither internal cleanliness, nor noble conduct, nor basic truthfulness can be found within them.

They boldly proclaim that the universe is completely devoid of truth, without a moral foundation (apratishtham), and without a governing God (anishvaram). They claim that life emerges purely from a mechanical clash of chemical forces, designed for nothing else besides raw, sensory lust (kama-haitukam).
simple_explanation: Krishna strikes directly at raw nihilism and predatory materialism. When a society adopts the view that there is no cosmic law, no accountability, and that human life is a temporary accident, then moral restraints evaporate. Society gets reconfigured into a savage jungle where might makes right.

translation: Anchoring their lives upon this toxic worldview, these ruined souls of small intelligence manifest as hostile, predatory agents of fierce, destructive deeds (ugra-karmanah), rising as a curse for the utter ruin and collapse of the world.

Surrendering themselves to insatiable consumerist lust (kamam dushpuram), overflowing with vanity, arrogance, and pride, driven by delusion, they clutch onto highly destructive, false concepts and move through life dedicated to unclean, unrighteous values.

Trapped inside infinite, crushing anxieties that never end until the hour of their death, looking upon the consumption of sensory pleasures as the apex goal of human existence, firmly convinced that "this material enjoyment is all that matters";

Bound tightly by hundreds of ropes of expectations and desires, entirely enslaved by lust and rage, they continuously strive to hoard mountains of material wealth using illegal, highly unjust methods (anyayena) simply to fuel their luxury.

They brag internally: "Today I have captured this massive asset; tomorrow I shall fulfill that specific desire! This wealth is already mine, and look at how much more financial profit is coming into my bank account next year!

I have completely neutralized that specific enemy corporate rival, and I shall destroy all my other competitors as well! I am the supreme sovereign ruler of my market; I am the ultimate enjoyer; I am highly successful, immensely powerful, and perfectly happy!

I am fabulously wealthy and born into a prestigious, elite family metric! Who else exists who can match my status? I shall perform splashy rituals, distribute cosmetic charities to buy public public visibility, and throw luxury celebrations!" Thus are they utterly blinded by dense ignorance.

Perplexed and unhinged by infinite, chaotic thoughts, caught tightly within the net of delusion, obsessively attached to the consumption of sensory luxuries, they slide straight down into a foul, hellish condition of psychological decay.

Self-glorifying, stubborn, completely intoxicated by the pride of raw wealth and status, they perform ostentatious rituals for name and display only (nama-yajnaiste), completely violating the spirit of systemic cosmic laws (avidhi-purvakam).

Taking firm refuge in raw egotism, brute force, pride, lust, and explosive rage, these malicious slanderers aggressively insult and violate My presence residing inside their own bodies and inside the bodies of their fellow human beings.

These cruel, hateful, and deeply degenerate low-born agents are continuously recycled by My cosmic laws across multiple lifetimes, cast straight into dark, animalistic, and predatory environments (asurishv-eva yonishu).
Trapped inside these brutal, animalistic configurations birth after birth, blinded by delusion, they fail completely to reach My presence, O continue

This is the threefold gateway to hellish degradation that brings about the absolute destruction and ruin of the Self—lust (Kama), anger (Krodha), and greed (Lobha). Therefore, one must thoroughly renounce these three dark attributes.

A human being who is completely liberated from these three gateways to darkness, O son of Kunti, acts systematically for the ultimate welfare of his own Self, and consequently ascends straight to the highest Destination.

He who entirely discards the structural injunctions and laws of the scriptures (shastra- vidhim), and moves through life driven solely by the whims of his personal desire and lust (kama-karatah), can never achieve spiritual perfection, nor earthly happiness, nor the supreme Destination.
simple_explanation: Shastra here does not refer to blind, medieval sectarian superstition. In its authentic Vedic definition, Shastra signifies the timeless system of universal laws, moral duties, and scientific principles recorded by unselfish sages for the structural maintenance of human society. If an individual claims he is "totally free" and decides to drive on whichever side of the road he desires based on his temporary whim, his absolute disregard for traffic laws (shastra-vidhi) will not bring him freedom—it will only bring smash-ups and death. Systematic, objective laws are the baseline of real human progress.

translation: Therefore, let the objective authority of universal laws and scripture (Shastram) be your unwavering metric when determining what fit to be done (karya) and what is fit to be avoided (akarya). Understanding the systematic duties outlined by legislative wisdom, you should execute your actions here in this world.
